page.overview:
Who is Daigian Moseneillin?

She had pale skin with long black hair and was plump and curvaceous. She wore the kesiera typical of many Cairhienin noblewomen. Hers is described as a moonstone dangling by a thin silver chain. She often wore clothes in the Cairhienin fashion. As the younger daughter of a minor Cairhienin house, she was entitled four stripes of color on her bosom. She added slashes of white to the skirts to represent her Ajah.

Daigian was loved and appreciated by the other sisters. Cadsuane Melaidhrin thinks that she had an excellent mind. She was considered a fine logician, and was extremely persistent and would never quit.

She logically assumed that, being the lowest-ranking Aes Sedai ever, she would have to act as servant when none were around and thus acted quiet and meek among all other sisters. Although she accepted her low rank as an Aes Sedai, she insisted on proper respect from non-Aes Sedai - both channelers and non-channelers. Aside from being stronger than those that would have been rejected by the Tower, other channelers still would be considered relatively untrained.

Daigian is described as exceptionally weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of , the "lowest level at which a woman traditionally was accepted for the Tower to become Aes Sedai". We know of no others as weak as her.
